get.summary:
What the app needs before sign-in (splash): company identity, languages, display formats,
feature switches, password rules and the minimum supported app version

patch.summary: Change what the employee may set directly: the language of server texts (labels, messages, e-mails, pushes)

get.summary: The employee's own photo (inline image); 404 when there is none

Every file about the employee in one answer: shared documents, contracts, training certificates,
letters issued on HR requests and payslips (latest 24), each with its authenticated download URL
The signed copy of one of the employee's own contracts (404 for any other id)

post.summary: Ask for a reset code. Always answers the same way, whether or not the address has an account
Check a reset code without using it (OTP screen). Wrong codes count towards the attempt limit
Set a new password with a valid reset code. Every token of the account is revoked

put.summary:
Change the password of the signed-in account. Other app tokens and web sessions are ended;
the token of this request stays valid

delete.summary: Revoke one app token of this account (404 when it is not one of yours)

CertificateType.description: Kind of certificate record kept for an employee.
CertificateType.title: CertificateType

ChangePasswordRequest.description:
The signed-in user changes their own password (portal account settings and PUT /api/v1/auth/password).
The current password is checked against the authenticated account of whichever guard served the request.
ChangePasswordRequest.title: ChangePasswordRequest

ForgotPasswordRequest.description: POST /api/v1/auth/password/forgot — asks for a reset code by e-mail.
ForgotPasswordRequest.title: ForgotPasswordRequest

GoalProgressRequest.description: A progress update: a percentage, or (KPIs) the actual value. Access is decided by the controller.
GoalProgressRequest.title: GoalProgressRequest

LeaveDayPart.description: Which part of the day a request covers. Partial parts are single-day requests.
LeaveDayPart.title: LeaveDayPart

LoanStatus.description: Life of an employee loan / advance. Active loans have an instalment schedule and an outstanding balance; completed ones are fully repaid.
LoanStatus.title: LoanStatus

LoanType.description: A loan (several instalments) or a salary advance (usually recovered from the next salary).
LoanType.title: LoanType

MobileAttendanceRequest.description:
POST /api/v1/me/attendance/check-in | check-out (JSON).

  request_uuid        uuid, generated by the app per tap (retries reuse it: idempotent)
  latitude, longitude decimal degrees
  accuracy            metres (horizontal accuracy reported by the OS)
  is_mock_location    bool, the OS / app mock-location indicator
  device_time         ISO-8601 with offset, the phone clock at capture
  device_id, platform (android|ios), app_version
  face                {token?, images?: [base64], liveness_passed?, liveness_score?}
MobileAttendanceRequest.title: MobileAttendanceRequest

OwnCertificateRequest.description:
A certificate / licence / qualification the employee uploads themselves (portal and API).
The file is required; type, size and extension follow Settings → Documents.
OwnCertificateRequest.title: OwnCertificateRequest

OwnCorrectionRequest.description:
An employee's correction request (portal and mobile API): own record only
(the controller resolves the employee from the account), past or current
dates, times in the branch timezone, optionally a "present" status such as
remote work or an official mission.
OwnCorrectionRequest.title: OwnCorrectionRequest

OwnLeaveRequest.description:
An employee's own leave request (portal and mobile API); the controller
resolves the employee from the signed-in account.
OwnLeaveRequest.title: OwnLeaveRequest

OwnLoanRequest.description: An employee's own loan / advance request (portal and mobile API).
OwnLoanRequest.title: OwnLoanRequest

OwnTrainingRequest.description: An employee's own request for a place on a session (portal and API).
OwnTrainingRequest.title: OwnTrainingRequest

ResetPasswordWithCodeRequest.description: POST /api/v1/auth/password/reset — sets a new password with a reset code (consumed on success).
ResetPasswordWithCodeRequest.title: ResetPasswordWithCodeRequest

ReviewRatingsRequest.description:
Ratings of a review: self-assessment (portal / API) or manager assessment (admin).
Ratings must be values of the cycle's scale — checked by ManagePerformanceReview,
which knows the scale. Access is decided by the controller (policy / ownership).

goals[{goal_id}][rating|comment], competencies[{review_competency_id}][rating|comment],
comments, strengths, improvements (manager only).
ReviewRatingsRequest.title: ReviewRatingsRequest

TrainingEnrolmentStatus.description: State of an employee's place on a training session. pending (awaiting approval) → enrolled → completed | failed | no_show; pending → rejected; pending / enrolled → cancelled.
TrainingEnrolmentStatus.title: TrainingEnrolmentStatus

UpdateMyProfileRequest.description:
PATCH /api/v1/me/profile — what the employee may change directly: their language.
Protected profile data is changed through a profile change request (HR requests).
UpdateMyProfileRequest.title: UpdateMyProfileRequest

UpdateNotificationPreferencesRequest.description:
preferences[event][channel] = 0|1 (web form: a hidden 0 before each checkbox; API: JSON booleans).
Unknown events / channels and mandatory events are ignored by NotificationPreferences::save().
UpdateNotificationPreferencesRequest.title: UpdateNotificationPreferencesRequest

VerifyResetCodeRequest.description: POST /api/v1/auth/password/verify-otp — checks a reset code (not consumed).
VerifyResetCodeRequest.title: VerifyResetCodeRequest

errors.description: A detailed description of each field that failed validation.
